svg.text: The Gardener — the Vault's First Production Pruning Cycle
§19 (extends §3.2 + §11): a caged proposal-only judge under governed identity · a human-reviewed sitting · evidence-bound stamps · archive with receipts. First complete cycle 2026-08-11.
Governed policy = judge identity
the pinned judge-prompt SHA-256 + the policy version
IS the judge's identity — edit one character and
stamping authority lapses until re-qualification
authority earned blind: 18/18 against the principal's
hand-marked fixture cases; the worse earlier prompt was
rejected, its failing scorecard preserved as the reason
the current wording exists
CAGED · $0 CEILING
The judge
a Cursor cloud sub-agent runs one pass under a
$0 enforceable spend ceiling — no provider API
path exists in its envelope
proposal-only: it writes no governed content
judging runs on schedule — weekly, via fleet-ops;
stamping is a separate gesture entirely
281 proposals (cycle 2)
one verdict per entry: finished / superseded /
abandoned — proposals only; nothing in the vault
changes until a human stamps
queued for the sitting — the judge cannot
dispose of its own proposals
HUMAN-REVIEWED SITTING — the human is the lever
stamping is a separate human-reviewed gesture — unattended auto-stamp is prohibited by standing rule
cycle 2: 14 proposals walked individually by the principal (every OS-segment item, every "abandoned" verdict);
the rest executive-reviewed span by span under a ruled policy
279 stamped · 2 held honestly on prospective-tense evidence · zero wrong verdicts found in ~280 spans read
Evidence-bound stamps
a stamp binds: the exact quoted span · its byte offsets · the body's
hash at judgment time · the judge's identity · the approving actor
edit a stamped body → the stamp is visibly stale and re-queues
a stamp can always prove — or lose — its own currency
Archive with receipts
75 entries archived with receipts · live working set: 3,297 active records
every failure in the cycle was a tooling seam, each now a filed, tracked
finding: a render-state-dependent content hash; two tools blind outside
the main store; a lock tool that corrupted its own record on an
apostrophe while printing success
content gate —
steady-state
cycles re-judge
only what
changed
The honest gap — the loop was wired for launching, not landing
the judge ran on schedule, and its 281 proposals sat unnoticed for
three days behind a status field written mid-run
Gardener v2 — design brief in the graph, superseding-in-design the v1 spec
closes the consumption loop: a pending-disposition marker + one boot-signal line ·
the disposition steps named in the loop's own procedure · confidence triage to shrink the sitting

Authority is a hash: the pinned prompt + policy version is the judge; the human sitting is the lever; every stamp carries the evidence to prove itself stale — and the gap between launching and landing is named, with its cure in design.
